title: design-md-chrome: reverse-engineers any website's design system into a structured SKILL.md

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Open any website, click the extension and design MD Chrome reverse engineers the entire design system, typography, colors, spacing, radi, shadows, and motion into a design.md or skill.mmd you hand directly to clawed code or codecs. follows the type UI format with accessibility constraints and do don't rules, not a token dump, an actual rule book your agent can
